scope: Same-window structural diagnostic only; no application or modification of product fidelity gates
exact_arithmetic_class: finite6347-sample A2 followed by a fixed linear time-invariant POST filter

bounds.derivation: Delta_hat=0 implies Delta=plus/minus signed sum of four errors. Triangle inequality gives minimax; Cauchy-Schwarz gives ||Delta||^2<=4*sum||e_i||^2. All norms use identical sample ranges and frozen per-channel anchors.

numerical_control.original_statistics_units: unscaled raw NAM output; retained unchanged in initial results.json
numerical_control.scope: Floating-point control for one existing A2+fixedPOST chain; not a uniform error bound over all weights/filtersettings
